indicators.title: Government portal ease of finding
indicators.description: Government portal(s) can be found on the first results page of any search engine typically used in that country

indicators.title: Advanced search options
indicators.description: Advanced search options that allow users to run custom searches with specific text, indicate unwanted words, specify date ranges, language options, etc.

indicators.title: Sitemap/Index
indicators.description: A sitemap or index with a list of all the available pages within the website accessible to users.

indicators.title: Contact details
indicators.description: Evidence of a “contact us” feature (e.g. phone numbers, email addresses, physical addresses, and sometimes online forms)

indicators.title: Accessibility by citizens/businesses to own data
indicators.description: The ability for users to access their own data ( government has on record).

indicators.title: Possibility for citizens/businesses to modify own data
indicators.description: The ability for users to modify their own data ( governments have on record).

indicators.title: Responsive web design
indicators.description: The portal displays and works well, easy reading and navigation with a minimum of resizing, panning, and scrolling — across a wide range of devices

indicators.title: Evidence of being updated in the past month
indicators.description: Evidence of the national government portal being updated in the past month, with updates applicable as evidence.

indicators.title: National portal(s) utilize HTTPS
indicators.description: Evidence of the national government portal uses HTTPS, as seen in address bar.

indicators.title: Save part of the transaction and access later
indicators.description: Ability to save and access later a transaction for a specific service that is initiated through the national portal(s) at any of the government portal(s

indicators.title: Access to list of previous interactions/transactions
indicators.description: The ability to access a list of users’ previous interactions/transactions in the national portal(s)at any of the government portal(s)

indicators.title: Availability of AI-chat-bot functionality
indicators.description: The provision of AI-enabled chat-bot" support functionality on any of the government website(s)

indicators.title: Compliant with W3C standards (CSS style sheet)
indicators.description: Compliant with the CSS style sheet standards set by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C).

indicators.title: Compliant with W3C standards (markup validity)
indicators.description: Compliant with the markup validity standards set by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C).
